payload.name: check_restaurant_availability
payload.description: Check restaurant time slots for a date. Read-only browsing - to actually book a table, call start_restaurant_booking.

on_date.description: The date to check, in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-20").

party_size.description: Number of guests (must be >= 1; ask the caller if not specified).
